title: Model and Evaluation: Towards Fairness in Multilingual Text Classification

Measuring Monolingual and Multilingual Equality Difference by calculating False Positive Rate (FPR) disparities between gender groups on a multilingual hate speech classification dataset.

Measuring Monolingual and Multilingual Equality Difference by calculating False Positive Rate (FPR) disparities between binarized racial groups (white vs. nonwhite) on a multilingual hate speech classification dataset.
